title: Moroccan Peanut Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan stew cooked to perfection in a clay pot. This dish is a perfect blend of spices and flavors.
instructions: Heat oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the Moroccan Spices, Cumin, Coriander, Salt, and Black Pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped Carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the diced Apricots and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the Peanuts and stir well. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot garnished with chopped Fresh Herbs, if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Moroccan Peanut Tagine!
